comparison.objective: Candidate depins one 5378 connector terminal; record releases a printed part by flexing a build plate, then bins it.
comparison.physical_skill: Recessed-tab blade insertion and coordinated wire/tool withdrawal versus controlled bimanual elastic plate bending.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires intended terminal extraction with housing, crimp, and neighbors intact; exact force/damage thresholds are missing. Record limits bend radius, drops, settling, plate return, and bin placement.
comparison.reason: Different mechanism and tested ability: latch release inside a connector versus safe elastic flexure and part separation.
